items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Margin Caution Offsets AI Demand
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Applied Materials has been revised slightly, easing from US$638.94 to US$620.78 as analysts refresh their models. This shift lines up with Street research that mixes caution on margins and discount rates with interest in AI driven wafer fab equipment and advanced packaging themes.
